subTitleDesc.sub_describe_en:
Course Description
To echo Schmidt's advocacy of marketing aesthetics and its competitive advantage in corporate identity management, the objectives of this course are: 1) to introduce relevant theories of design elements and principles; 2) to train students' ability to practice design concepts; 3) to cultivate students' visual communication literacy and skills.

description.describe_ch: 為呼應史密特倡議的行銷美感及其在企業識別管理上的競爭優勢，本課程目標為：1）介紹設計元素和原則之相關理論；2）訓練學生實踐設計概念的能力；3）培養學生視覺溝通的識讀能力與素養。
description.describe_eh: Simonson & Schmitt (1997) argues that a company's total aesthetic output -- its "look and feel" -- provides a vital competitive advantage. In order to improve Marketing students’ aesthetic literacy and ability to practice, this course: (1) introduces the theory of design elements and principles; (2) prepares the students' ability to realise design concepts and ideas; (3) cultivates students’ visual literacy for visual communication and design.

iSoftwares.soft_memo:
CapCut 是 TikTok 的官方免費視頻編輯器和帶有音樂的視頻製作軟體，
全功能影片編輯器，讓所有人隨時隨地創作任何內容
彈性靈活的編輯、神奇的 AI 工具、最佳的AI 工具,利用 CapCut 易於使用的工具揮灑創意。團隊合作，還有庫存素材，讓影片創作變得前所未有的輕鬆。用途廣泛且易於使用。

除了視頻編輯、文本、貼紙、濾鏡、顏色和音樂等基本功能外，CapCut 還提供免費的高級功能，包括Ai文本、影片生成、關鍵幀動畫、平滑的慢動作效果、色度鍵、畫中畫 (PIP)、和穩定性可幫助您捕捉和剪切精彩瞬間。
iSoftwares.soft_memo_en:
Software Tools, Description
Catcut App, "CapCut is TikTok's official free video editor and video creation software with music. It is a full-featured video editor that allows everyone to create any content anytime, anywhere with flexible and easy editing, amazing AI tools, and the best AI tools. Use CapCut's easy-to-use tools to unleash your creativity. With team collaboration and stock materials, video creation has never been easier. It is widely used and easy to use. In addition to basic functions such as video editing, text, stickers, filters, colors, and music, CapCut also provides free advanced features including AI text, video generation, keyframe animation, smooth slow-motion effects, chroma key, picture-in-picture (PIP), and stabilization to help you capture and cut exciting moments."

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
同學應準時上下課，課堂上請遵守上課秩序，不得有影響上課脫序行為。
課堂與同學互動時，務必尊重多元文化與性別平權等問題。
製作影音作品時，請尊重不同立場的政治、宗教態度，切勿有歧視、嘲諷、言詞霸凌等行為。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Class Rules and Reminders:
1.Students should be on time for class. Please maintain order in the classroom and refrain from disruptive behavior that affects the class.

2.When interacting with classmates in class, it is essential to respect issues such as multiculturalism and gender equality.

3.When producing video works, please respect different political and religious stances and refrain from discriminatory, mocking, or verbal bullying behavior.

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
